en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large neoclassical palace with a central portico of tall columns, symmetrical wings, balustrades and statues on the roof. A flag flies above the central pediment. In the foreground is a lawn with a few people walking. Trees frame the scene. The upper caption in German reads "Putbus (auf Rügen). Schloss." and there is a large red handwritten number "1462" near the top. Small printed text runs along the bottom margin.
